findings.claim: The diff adds a new product module, frontend/src/components/office/excelRunOn.ts (294 lines, holding the whole run-on step), but the touch-point list names only excelAdapter.ts for product code and ends with 'No other file'.
findings.impact: No user-visible effect. The module runs only through excelAdapter.ts:261-263, which is a listed touch point. The planned file list is incomplete, so a reviewer who checks code against the touch points would not expect to find the run-on logic in a separate file.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/components/office/excelAdapter.ts:3 imports runOnTextOverflow from './excelRunOn'. frontend/src/components/office/excelRunOn.ts:266-294 exports runOnTextOverflow, and lines 1-264 hold candidate selection, measurement, range parsing and merge writing. The spec's Touch points list excelAdapter.ts, the two test files, INDEX.md and the user guide, followed by 'No other file. No protected path.' Grep finds no importer other than excelAdapter.ts.
findings.repro: Compare the files in the diff with the Touch points section of docs/specs/excel-text-overflow.md. excelRunOn.ts is in the diff and not in the list.

bucket_proposal.reason: No invariant is broken. The file is a split of the planned excelAdapter.ts step, but the touch-point list says 'No other file', so the plan and the change disagree.

findings.proposed_fix: Add frontend/src/components/office/excelRunOn.ts to the touch points in docs/process/reviews/feature-excel-text-overflow/invariants.md, as the module that holds the run-on step called from transformData.

findings.claim: The measuring canvas is appended to and removed from the library's container during preview, which also reaches drawExcel's own inputLock MutationObserver (excelAdapter.ts:310-315, childList and subtree on the same container). That observer is not named in the touch points.
findings.impact: Nothing a user would notice. The mutations queue one extra lockInputs on the next animation frame. lockInputs makes inputs read-only and blurs only a focused element inside the container, and it runs after drawing anyway.
findings.evidence: excelAdapter.ts:315 observes `container` with { childList: true, subtree: true }. excelAdapter.ts:277 passes the same `container` as `host`. excelRunOn.ts:278 calls host.appendChild(canvas) and excelRunOn.ts:292 calls made.canvas?.remove(), both inside instance.preview (excelAdapter.ts:364), after the observer is installed.

bucket_proposal.reason: This interaction is outside the listed touch points. It breaks no invariant and has no visible effect.

specification_compliance: The touch points cover every file in the diff except frontend/src/components/office/excelRunOn.ts (R1). The spec, INDEX.md and review records are implicit touch points.
excelAdapter.ts: the run-on runs in its own try after the sizing try (lines 251-263), as §1.1 requires.
The canvas is created lazily on the first measurement, given display:none, appended to the library's container, and removed in a finally (excelRunOn.ts:272-293), as §1.3 requires.
When the context is null or getContext throws, the pass returns false before any merge is written. The context is obtained before the first write, so I7 holds.
Merge and range are computed first and then written on consecutive lines with nothing that can throw between them (excelRunOn.ts:224-228), as §1.5 requires.
potential_unspecified_behavior: Appending and removing the measuring canvas triggers drawExcel's inputLock MutationObserver once more (R2). The spec does not describe this; it is harmless.
regression_risks: Any future importer of excelRunOn.ts would sit outside the spec's plan, because the module is not listed in the touch points.
test_coverage: FilePreview.excelTextOverflow.test.tsx tests the canvas's parent, display and removal, including when a step throws and when measureText throws.
FilePreview.excelActualSize.test.tsx only stubs getContext to width 0 so the run-on step changes nothing; none of its assertions changed.
